Batch scrape with one URL failing returns partial results

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Crawlberg;

var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(null);
var urls = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>(new string[] { "https://example.com/good1", "https://example.com/bad", "https://example.com/good2" });
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.BatchScrapeAsync(engine, urls);
Console.WriteLine(result.CompletedCount);
Console.WriteLine(result.FailedCount);
Console.WriteLine(result.TotalCount);
```
